title: Goose
summary: Goose (aaif-goose/goose) driven by agentd's built-in adapter. agentd installs the vendor's pinned release archive itself.
description: A first-party descriptor of one of agentd's built-in harness adapters (design 73 section 8, D1464). The listing describes Loams' adapter, which is Apache-2.0 and ships inside loams-agentd; agentd downloads the vendor's pinned release archive, checked by digest, into its own data directory. The vendor's software is separate, under its own licence and terms. agentd launches it as `goose acp` from an empty environment and speaks ACP over stdio (D1809); its model provider is pointed at agentd's model proxy, which holds the key.
